current.text: Poole is probably out of the rotation in New Orleans.
Poole is not named in any projected Pelicans starting lineup. Dejounte Murray is locked in at guard, and the last starting spot is between Jeremiah Fears and Herb Jones.
The New Orleans guard group includes Dejounte Murray, who is back, second-year Jeremiah Fears and new addition Bennedict Mathurin. The team also has a new coach, Jamahl Mosley.
The Pelicans have a crowded rotation, with about eight players who could all start.
The experts say the Pelicans have too many players for 240 minutes and unclear guard roles, so roles are hard to project.
The experts see New Orleans as a weak team that will not make the playoffs. One projects about 34 wins.

durable.text: One expert admits that he often gets Poole wrong, so expert calls on him are less reliable.

note: Poole is not a draft target for us. Both Yahoo and ESPN value him at 0 USD (ranks 190 and 241), and his projected line of about 41% FG on 10 shots does no real damage in any category but hurts FG% more than it helps elsewhere, so the 10 USD our league paid last season is not worth repeating. Leave him on waivers and check early whether injuries or a trade in the crowded New Orleans backcourt give him real minutes. Only then is he worth adding for FT% and threes.
